hints.title: Task Cooldown Constraints
hints.text: Identical tasks must be separated by at least cooldown intervals of other tasks or idle cycles.

hints.title: Earliest Available Timestamp
hints.text: For each task, the earliest allowed slot is max(current_time + 1, last_seen[task] + cooldown + 1).

hints.title: Chronological Simulation
hints.text: Track the last execution timestamp of each task using a hash map and advance the clock greedily.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

variables: N: number of tasks to schedule
U: number of unique task types
complexity.notes: Greedy sequential timeline simulation tracking previous task completion times.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating every clock tick individually when idle gaps are large causes unnecessary iterations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Maintains timestamp map of size U.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Advance timeline mathematically using max(current + 1, last + cooldown + 1).
